items.headline: Texas rises to No. 1 in AP Top 25; Ohio State, Oregon tumble

items.headline: Dampier accounts for 4 touchdowns as No. 20 Utah dominates Arkansas
items.description: — Devon Dampier threw for two touchdowns and ran for two more, Wayshawn Parker added three scores and No. 20 Utah overpowered Arkansas 43-10 on Saturday night.
